task.question: Who was dismissed as defence minister in Ukraine on July 15, 2026?
task.evidence: 15 July – Dismissal of Mykhailo Fedorov: President Zelenskyy dismisses defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov, sparking nationwide protests.

answer: FINAL: Mykhailo Fedorov was dismissed as defence minister of Ukraine on July 15, 2026, by President Volodymyr Zelenskyy as part of a wider cabinet reshuffle.
